attribution: Drafted with AI; the gallery text is unsigned on the site
method: The 46 works the collector holds by nnxyz on chains other than Gnosis (data/onchain.json): 38 on Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum and Polygon recovered by the Mac session on October 16, 2026, and 8 on Tezos recorded from objkt and TzKT. Every work was viewed on one contact sheet and at up to 1000 px before the rooms were formed. Rooms follow the order the tokens entered the collector's wallets, with the artist's series kept together. Dates are UTC; recordedAt is the mint instant where the chain records it.
description: Forty-six works from after the drawing board: pixel twins of the Faces, a club of flat cats, the index collection on four chains, noise fields and generated pictures, and seven friends of country air. Two rooms.
dateBasis: UTC. recordedAt is the token mint instant where known (Tezos; tokens the collector minted himself); null where the artist minted before the transfer. collectedAt is the first transfer into a collector wallet.
